verdict.rationale: Unleash's Admin API is documented as providing 'comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources,' covering feature flags, environments, RBAC, change requests, segments, and more—mirroring UI capabilities. It also ships an official MCP server so AI agents can manage flags programmatically, and API tokens/SDKs are core to the product's design for automation-first workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that every UI action (e.g., release templates, impact metrics automation) has a 1:1 API equivalent, and no explicit documentation addressing edge-case UI-only features.
